title: Prevent clipped focus rings on modal buttons using Modal.ButtonRow
answers: Why is the focus ring cut off on buttons in a modal?
How to prevent button focus rings from being clipped in modals?
How should button rows be structured in Grafana modal dialogs?
body:
Symptom: Focus ring around modal buttons is cut off or clipped.
Root cause: packages/grafana-ui/src/components/ConfirmModal/ConfirmContent.tsx:ConfirmContent rendered buttons inside a custom container and Stack lacking focus ring clearance.
Fix pattern: Wrap modal buttons in Modal.ButtonRow instead of custom containers or layout stacks.
Constraints: Applies to button rows inside modals; does not apply to non-modal button groups.
